task.description:
Design integration test specifications and test implementations for EXP-301, EXP-302, EXP-303.

Scope:
1. EXP-301: Async effects subsystem
   - Effects outbox transactional append + query for due rows
   - Worker polling, delivery attempt with backoff/retry schedule
   - Success path: mark delivered, emit EFFECT_COMPLETED event, re-enter into instance
   - Retry path: mark for retry, next_retry_at updated per backoff schedule
   - DLQ path: mark dead-lettered after max retries exhausted, emit EFFECT_FAILED event
   - HTTP delivery adapter: makes requests with Idempotency-Key header
   - Idempotency: repeated effect appends are deduplicated via idempotency key
   - Test scenarios: normal delivery, transient failures with retry, permanent failures to DLQ, header injection, backoff timing

2. EXP-302: Service-task migration to effect emit-and-wait
   - SERVICE_TASK node in transition function now emits effect_emitted event instead of inline I/O
   - Optional sync_inline:true flag routes to synchronous delivery (backwards compatibility)
   - Instance state transitions from RUNNING → EFFECT_WAIT until EFFECT_COMPLETED arrives
   - Test scenarios: async effect emission (Path A), sync-inline fallback (Path B), instance waits correctly, re-entry on completion

3. EXP-303: Stub effects executor for sandbox/deterministic testing
   - Stub executor records effect specs, counts per kind, can be configured to return success or failure
   - reset() clears state between tests for isolation
   - Test scenarios: counter assertions, recorded effect inspection, deterministic response mode, reset isolation

Acceptance Criteria (MUST):
- Every EXP-301/302/303 acceptance criterion has at least one integration test
- Integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL (BPM_TEST_DB_URL)
- All tests are self-sufficient (generate fresh UUIDs, clean up after themselves)
- No test.skip on MUST requirement tests
- No mocks/stubs except explicit sandbox stub for EXP-303
- Stub executor tests verify determinism and reset behavior
- Worker timing tests verify backoff schedule is honored

Deliverables:
1. Test spec files: tests/specs/EXP-301.md, tests/specs/EXP-302.md, tests/specs/EXP-303.md
2. Test implementation: tests/integration/effects_subsystem_test.zig (or split by scenario type)
3. All spec files and test code committed to feature branch
acceptance_criteria: Test specs written for EXP-301, EXP-302, EXP-303 covering all acceptance criteria
Integration test files implement specs with real PostgreSQL connections
All MUST requirement tests are present (no skip)
Test fixtures use per-test UUIDs and cleanup after themselves
Stub executor test verifies counter/recording/reset behavior
All test files committed to feature branch

result.summary: Test specifications and integration tests for EXP-301/302/303
